## Problem / Motivation

Describe the problem you're trying to solve or what is currently missing. Explain why this feature would be useful before describing the solution.

## Proposed Solution

Describe how you think this could be implemented. Include any relevant details, examples, or expected behavior.

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions or approaches you've considered and why you think the proposed solution is a better fit.

## Additional Context

Add any mockups, diagrams, screenshots, links, or related issues that might help explain the feature request.
